During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''bartender''' served [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Corellian whiskey)|bounty hunter]] sixteen mugs of [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]]. Skywalker was extracting information from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] by getting him drunk while using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Curato salva|nullify]] the [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] in his system. After asking for directions of [[Margess Base]], the bartender hoped that Skywalker was not intending to drive a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] there after imbibing so much [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]]. Skywalker used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to make the bartender forget.<ref name="RPG" />
